title: Zero anticoagulation, zero thrombolysis: successful management of massive pulmonary embolism following hemorrhagic transformation of acute ischemic stroke: a case report
description: Figure 1 Non-contrast head CT images. (A) Day 4 after cerebral thrombectomy: initial development of patchy high-density areas (arrows), indicative of early hemorrhagic transformation. (B) Day 6 after cerebral thrombectomy: progressive expansion and coalescence of the hemorrhage (arrows). (C) Day 12 after cerebral thrombectomy: slight reduction in the size and density of the hemorrhage (arrows). (D) Day 17 after cerebral thrombectomy (pre-pulmonary intervention): re-expansion of the hemorrhage (arrows). (E) Day 7 after pulmonary thrombectomy: stability of the intracranial hemorrhage, confirming no procedure-related exacerbation (arrows).
